recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-21646 unless a future ballot changes Provenance.activity search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-21646 was a Published/Persuasive Security WG change request asking for a Provenance.activity query parameter to support queries against Provenance for specific activities. Jira records it as raised against STU3, applied for R5, with a May 2019 affirmative vote and a PR #708 application comment.
initial_application: The PR-linked history applied the request in the old Provenance spreadsheet source: commit b569c4406b1d2a7944cc4b25869f7075524fe4f3 added an activity/token/Provenance.activity row to source/provenance/provenance-spreadsheet.xml, and merge commit e5f777ad514d570245abf181a3637f154a2529a9 brought PR #708 into main history. The 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 converted that source into bundle-Provenance-search-params.xml while preserving Provenance-activity.
additional_context: Provenance is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current search parameter bundle defines SearchParameter/Provenance-activity with code activity, type token, expression Provenance.activity, and normal processing. Security WG Zulip and Confluence records list GF/CP#21646 as the Provenance.activity query-parameter item; no conflicting later community or tracker evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/provenance/bundle-Provenance-search-params.xml already contains the requested active build input for Provenance.activity search.

related_jiras.note: Appeared in the same Security WG Provenance.activity block-vote trail but concerns the activity vocabulary, not the search parameter requested by FHIR-21646. It was not decided here.
